subject.title: fix(web-fetch): forward NO_PROXY to EnvHttpProxyAgent options so env proxy respects bypass entries

question: Should this PR be accepted as a narrow EnvHttpProxyAgent option-snapshot hardening even though it does not resolve the local/private NO_PROXY behavior tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93807?
rationale: The code change is small, but it sits on proxy routing and SSRF-adjacent behavior where maintainer intent is needed to separate narrow option forwarding from the broader direct-local NO_PROXY policy.

options.title: Accept narrow hardening after proof
options.body: Require focused tests, corrected Undici-supported wording, removal of the closing claim, and real proxied runtime proof before landing this as helper hardening only.

options.title: Pause for canonical policy
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers choose the complete security-reviewed NO_PROXY behavior for the canonical issue and then close or adapt duplicate candidates.

options.title: Close as not worth the partial path
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers decide partial EnvHttpProxyAgent option forwarding adds compatibility risk without enough value outside the canonical fix.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow hardening after proof
recommendation.body: Require focused tests, corrected Undici-supported wording, removal of the closing claim, and real proxied runtime proof before landing this as helper hardening only.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the web_fetch trusted env proxy opt-in and owns several adjacent NO_PROXY/proxy helper commits.
